doc.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18

title: Bris Jones: birth and name
summary: Allen brings up Jones, who says he was born in Bogalusa, Louisiana, on July 12, 1926, full name Malcolm Brister Jones.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Well, I think that just about covers your background. Why don't we see if we can get next. What about Chris up here? Chris, can you come over and do a little talking?
Yeah, well, I'll do a little talking.
Let's see. I don't say anything bad about James.

Yeah. Swear to tell the truth, the whole truth, nothing but the truth shall help you forward. This is going in the jazz archive. Going in the jazz archives. Yeah, and also we want to get a little background, just enough for the album notes, you see. Like, when you were born and where?
Well, that's what you want? Well, Bogalusa, 1926. Bogalusa, Louisiana.
They just called you Briss, huh?
That's right. Not Malcolm, I hope.
